voice.input_audio: Audio files: WAV, MP3, AIFF, AAC, OGG, FLAC, MPEG, M4A, L16, Opus, ALAW, MULAW and WebM; sample-rate limits not stated [transcribe-guide]
voice.output_audio: None: the model returns text, not generated speech
languages: 85+ supported languages and locales; the full BCP-47 table is on the model page [transcribe-model]
voice.turn_detection: No interactive turn detector: one audio file per request
voice.interruption: Not a speaking assistant; no generated speech to interrupt
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis reports median processing speed 91.1 audio seconds per processing second on its recent 10-minute-file runs; throughput, not latency [aa-non-streaming]
voice.session_limit: Up to 1 hour of audio per request; up to 30 minutes with diarization or word timestamps [transcribe-model]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Gemini API Standard paid plan. Input is audio and output is transcript text, USD per million tokens. Pricing page estimates 25 audio tokens/second and 175 output text tokens/minute, about $0.005 per minute combined; actual token use determines the bill. Free tier offered; no caching, Batch, Flex or Priority [pricing] [transcribe-model]
